package.description: Advanced 2 and 3-way file comparison (diff), merging, and folder synchronization

en-GB.description: Advanced 2 and 3-way file comparison (diff), merging, and folder synchronization
en-GB.longDescription:
Araxis Merge for Windows and macOS is an advanced two and three-way file comparison (diff), merging, and folder synchronization application that supports text, binary, and image comparisons.

Key features:
- Text comparisons: Side-by-side diffs with syntax highlighting.
- Three-way merging: Visualize and resolve conflicts between base, source, and target versions.
- Folder synchronization: Compare and merge entire directory trees.
- Version control: Integrates with Git, Mercurial, Subversion, and Perforce.
- Office documents: Compare Microsoft Office, OpenDocument, PDF, and RTF files.
- Automation: Command-line support and scripting API.

Try Araxis Merge free. Evaluations are fully functional but expire after 30 days.
en-GB.name: Araxis Merge
